title.narrative: Global Plastics Offer (GPO) – Support the Start-up Phase (Engagement Facility)

description.narrative: UNDP entered into a global partnership with the Ocean Cleanup in support of the implementation of UNDP’s Plastics Offer. The goal of the partnership is to jointly develop solutions for the reduction of leakages of plastics into marine ecosystems from rivers, basins and terrestrial and marine resources through deployment of technologies, policy advocacy and behavior change. This global partnership builds on the experiences and lessons learned from the national level cooperation between UNDP-Dominican Republic and the Ocean Cleanup. Eight priority countries have been identified for this partnership considering various factors including pollution status, existing relationship, and past/ongoing plastic work. The 8 countries are Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, India, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, and Jamaica.
